% =============================================================================
% specforge -- main document.
% Copied to <project>/build/main.tex by the build and compiled from
% the project folder with -output-directory=build. Every \input path below is
% relative to the project folder. Do not edit the copy in build/.
%
% Generated files (build/):
%   sf-config    every style value as a macro
%   sf-metadata  document information from project.md
%   sf-class     \documentclass line
%   sf-setup     geometry, colours, fonts, captions, PDF properties
%   sf-titlefields, sf-front, sf-body   title-page fields, front matter, chapters
% Static files (build/sf/, copied from latex/template/preamble and latex/tikz):
%   packages, typography, tables, tikz, macros, titlepage, frontmatter
% =============================================================================
\input{build/sf-config}
\input{build/sf-metadata}
\input{build/sf-class}
\input{build/sf/packages}
\input{build/sf-setup}
\input{build/sf/typography}
\input{build/sf/tables}
\input{build/sf/tikz}
\input{build/sf/macros}

\begin{document}

\pagenumbering{\sfPageFrontMatterNumbering}
\input{build/sf/titlepage}
\input{build/sf/frontmatter}

\pagenumbering{\sfPageBodyNumbering}
\input{build/sf-body}

\end{document}
